resources.string: Sawn uses Accessibility to detect when a blocked app or website is opened so it can show the stop screen, and to preview the browser address bar and the social-app images in front of you, locally on this device. When needed it takes a transient screenshot of the foreground window, classifies it on-device, then discards it immediately. Sawn never stores screen text or images and never sends any of it anywhere.
